properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for JWT tokens.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: Access token expiration time in milliseconds (e.g. 900000 = 15 min).

properties.name: jwt.refresh-expiration
properties.description: Refresh token expiration time in milliseconds (e.g. 604800000 = 7 days).

properties.name: audit.log.retention-days
properties.description: Number of days to retain audit log entries before cleanup.

properties.name: audit.log.cleanup-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the scheduled audit log cleanup job.

properties.name: auth.refresh-token.cleanup-retain-days
properties.description: Number of days to retain expired or revoked refresh tokens before deletion.

properties.name: auth.refresh-token.cleanup-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the scheduled refresh token cleanup job.

properties.name: rate.limit.auth.requests
properties.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per window for auth endpoints (login, forgot-password).

properties.name: rate.limit.auth.window.minutes
properties.description: Rate-limit window duration in minutes for auth endpoints.

properties.name: rate.limit.api.requests
properties.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per window for general authenticated API endpoints.

properties.name: rate.limit.api.window.minutes
properties.description: Rate-limit window duration in minutes for general API endpoints.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed by the CORS policy (e.g. http://localhost:5173).

properties.name: spring.mail.from
properties.description: The 'From' address used for outgoing application emails.
